name: Freight: load subject (public tracking)
description: A short tracking pass meant to be repeated under load. Each step is timed separately, so a load run shows which one degrades when many browsers track shipments at once.

load_plans.name: Quick smoke (90s, 3 users)
load_plans.description: Three browsers tracking shipments for a minute and a half: enough to see the setup works and get a first per-step picture.

load_plans.name: Rush hour (5 min, 6 users)
load_plans.description: Six browsers for five minutes, ramped over the first minute. Compare it on release 1.0.0 and 1.1.0: the tracking steps are where a slow database shows.
